title: FE Accessory Orbit [SOURCE -30] [OPEN SOURCE]
script:
--[[
    Community Accessory Orbit
    -------------------------
    Simple equipped-accessory orbit with the Source -30 netless-style write.

    Important:
    Source -30 helps keep locally owned accessory physics stable in experiences
    where the client retains ownership. It does not guarantee replication or
    protection in every game; the server still has final authority.

    Controls:
      RightShift  - show / hide menu
      Toggle      - orbit currently equipped accessories
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
if not LP then return end

local SOURCE_VELOCITY = Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0)

local ORBIT_RADIUS = 5.5
local ORBIT_HEIGHT = 1.25
local ORBIT_SPEED = 1.35
local ITEM_SPIN_SPEED = 1.8
local RESCAN_INTERVAL = 0.25

local GUI_NAME = "CommunityAccessoryOrbit"
local ENV_KEY = "__CommunityAccessoryOrbitUnload"

local env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if type(env[ENV_KEY]) == "function" then
    pcall(env[ENV_KEY])
end

local playerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild(GUI_NAME)
if old then old:Destroy() end

local alive = true
local orbitEnabled = false
local orbitClock = 0
local lastScan = 0

local records = {}
local connections = {}

local function track(c)
    connections[#connections + 1] = c
    return c
end

local function character()
    return LP.Character
end

local function rootPart()
    local char = character()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function accessoryJoints(char, accessory, handle)
    local out = {}
    if not (char and accessory and handle) then return out end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("JointInstance") or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            local ok, p0, p1 = pcall(function()
                return obj.Part0, obj.Part1
            end)

            if ok and (p0 == handle or p1 == handle) then
                local other = (p0 == handle) and p1 or p0
                if other
                    and other:IsA("BasePart")
                    and other:IsDescendantOf(char)
                    and not other:IsDescendantOf(accessory)
                then
                    out[#out + 1] = {
                        joint = obj,
                        parent = obj.Parent,
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function detachRecord(record)
    local handle = record.handle
    if not (handle and handle.Parent) then return end

    for _, info in ipairs(record.joints) do
        if info.joint and info.joint.Parent then
            info.joint.Parent = nil
        end
    end

    handle.Anchored = false
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.CanTouch = false
    handle.CanQuery = false
    handle.Massless = true
end

local function restoreRecord(record)
    local handle = record.handle

    if handle and handle.Parent then
        pcall(function()
            handle.CanCollide = record.canCollide
            handle.CanTouch = record.canTouch
            handle.CanQuery = record.canQuery
            handle.Massless = record.massless
        end)
    end

    for _, info in ipairs(record.joints) do
        if info.joint
            and info.joint.Parent == nil
            and info.parent
            and info.parent.Parent
        then
            pcall(function()
                info.joint.Parent = info.parent
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function addAccessory(accessory)
    if records[accessory] then return records[accessory] end
    if not accessory:IsA("Accessory") then return nil end

    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end

    local char = character()
    if not char then return nil end

    local record = {
        accessory = accessory,
        handle = handle,
        joints = accessoryJoints(char, accessory, handle),

        canCollide = handle.CanCollide,
        canTouch = handle.CanTouch,
        canQuery = handle.CanQuery,
        massless = handle.Massless,
    }

    records[accessory] = record

    if orbitEnabled then
        detachRecord(record)
    end

    return record
end

local function scanAccessories()
    local char = character()
    if not char then return end

    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") then
            addAccessory(child)
        end
    end

    for accessory, record in pairs(records) do
        if not accessory.Parent or not accessory:IsDescendantOf(char) then
            records[accessory] = nil
        elseif record.handle and record.handle.Parent then
            -- Keep body welds from being silently recreated.
            local newJoints = accessoryJoints(char, accessory, record.handle)
            for _, info in ipairs(newJoints) do
                local known = false
                for _, oldInfo in ipairs(record.joints) do
                    if oldInfo.joint == info.joint then
                        known = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not known then
                    record.joints[#record.joints + 1] = info
                end
            end

            if orbitEnabled then
                detachRecord(record)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function recordList()
    local list = {}
    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        if record.handle and record.handle.Parent then
            list[#list + 1] = record
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return a.accessory.Name < b.accessory.Name
    end)
    return list
end

local function applySource30(handle)
    if not (handle and handle.Parent) then return end

    -- Keep these AFTER every CFrame / physics operation.
    -- This is the actual "Source -30" part.
    handle.Velocity = SOURCE_VELOCITY
    handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = SOURCE_VELOCITY
end

local function updateOrbit(dt)
    if not orbitEnabled then return end

    local root = rootPart()
    if not root then return end

    orbitClock += dt * ORBIT_SPEED

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastScan >= RESCAN_INTERVAL then
        lastScan = now
        scanAccessories()
    end

    local list = recordList()
    local count = #list
    if count == 0 then return end

    for index, record in ipairs(list) do
        local handle = record.handle
        if handle and handle.Parent then
            detachRecord(record)

            local angle = orbitClock + ((index - 1) / count) * math.pi * 2
            local localOffset = Vector3.new(
                math.cos(angle) * ORBIT_RADIUS,
                ORBIT_HEIGHT + math.sin(angle * 2) * 0.35,
                math.sin(angle) * ORBIT_RADIUS
            )

            local worldPosition = root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
            local spin = orbitClock * ITEM_SPIN_SPEED + index * 0.35

            handle.CFrame =
                CFrame.new(worldPosition)
                * CFrame.Angles(
                    math.sin(angle) * 0.22,
                    -angle + math.pi * 0.5,
                    spin
                )

            handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

            -- FINAL velocity write.
            applySource30(handle)
        end
    end
end

local function setOrbit(on)
    orbitEnabled = on == true

    if orbitEnabled then
        orbitClock = 0
        lastScan = 0
        scanAccessories()

        for _, record in pairs(records) do
            detachRecord(record)
            applySource30(record.handle)
        end
    else
        for _, record in pairs(records) do
            restoreRecord(record)
        end
    end
end

-- UI

local unload

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = GUI_NAME
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
gui.Parent = playerGui

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 212)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0.5, -106)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 24)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 51, 62)
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Parent = main

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 22)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 14
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 247)
title.Text = "ACCESSORY ORBIT"
title.Parent = main

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "Close"
closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 8)
closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 26)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(156, 53, 61)
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeButton.TextSize = 14
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 240)
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.AutoButtonColor = true
closeButton.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", closeButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

track(closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unload then
        unload()
    end
end))

local sourceLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
sourceLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
sourceLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 33)
sourceLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 17)
sourceLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
sourceLabel.TextSize = 11
sourceLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
sourceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(108, 219, 174)
sourceLabel.Text = "SOURCE  Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0)"
sourceLabel.Parent = main

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 60)
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 42)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(37, 42, 51)
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.TextSize = 12
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(231, 236, 244)
toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
toggle.Text = "ORBIT  •  OFF"
toggle.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", toggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local function makeAdjustRow(y, labelText, minusText, plusText)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, y)
    label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 30)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 181, 198)
    label.Text = labelText
    label.Parent = main

    local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, y)
    minus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 30)
    minus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31, 35, 43)
    minus.BorderSizePixel = 0
    minus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    minus.TextSize = 14
    minus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 234)
    minus.Text = minusText
    minus.Parent = main
    Instance.new("UICorner", minus).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

    local plus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, y)
    plus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 30)
    plus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31, 35, 43)
    plus.BorderSizePixel = 0
    plus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    plus.TextSize = 14
    plus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 234)
    plus.Text = plusText
    plus.Parent = main
    Instance.new("UICorner", plus).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

    return label, minus, plus
end

local radiusLabel, radiusMinus, radiusPlus =
    makeAdjustRow(112, "", "-", "+")

local speedLabel, speedMinus, speedPlus =
    makeAdjustRow(148, "", "-", "+")

local footer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
footer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 183)
footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18)
footer.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
footer.TextSize = 10
footer.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
footer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(112, 123, 140)
footer.Text = "RightShift hides menu  •  rescans equipped accessories"
footer.Parent = main

local function refreshUi()
    toggle.Text = orbitEnabled and "ORBIT  •  ON" or "ORBIT  •  OFF"
    toggle.BackgroundColor3 =
        orbitEnabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(83, 196, 158)
        or Color3.fromRGB(37, 42, 51)

    toggle.TextColor3 =
        orbitEnabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(10, 30, 24)
        or Color3.fromRGB(231, 236, 244)

    radiusLabel.Text = ("RADIUS   %.1f"):format(ORBIT_RADIUS)
    speedLabel.Text = ("SPEED    %.2f"):format(ORBIT_SPEED)
end

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setOrbit(not orbitEnabled)
    refreshUi()
end)

radiusMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ORBIT_RADIUS = math.max(1.5, ORBIT_RADIUS - 0.5)
    refreshUi()
end)

radiusPlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ORBIT_RADIUS = math.min(20, ORBIT_RADIUS + 0.5)
    refreshUi()
end)

speedMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ORBIT_SPEED = math.max(0.1, ORBIT_SPEED - 0.15)
    refreshUi()
end)

speedPlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ORBIT_SPEED = math.min(8, ORBIT_SPEED + 0.15)
    refreshUi()
end)

-- simple drag
do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart
    local startPos

    track(main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = main.Position
        end
    end))

    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            main.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end))

    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))
end

track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        main.Visible = not main.Visible
    end
end))

track(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    setOrbit(false)
    table.clear(records)
    task.wait(0.5)
    scanAccessories()
    refreshUi()
end))

track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(updateOrbit))

unload = function()
    if not alive then return end
    alive = false

    setOrbit(false)

    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function()
            c:Disconnect()
        end)
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    if gui and gui.Parent then
        gui:Destroy()
    end

    if env[ENV_KEY] == unload then
        env[ENV_KEY] = nil
    end
end

env[ENV_KEY] = unload

scanAccessories()
refreshUi()
features:
A lightweight community accessory orbit built around the Source -30 method.

Equipped accessories are detached and driven in a live orbit around your character while the script continuously watches for newly equipped accessories and recreated body welds. Source Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0) is kept as the final velocity write each Heartbeat to help keep accessory physics stable when the client retains network ownership.

The goal of this release is to expose the Source -30 technique in a small, readable script instead of hiding it inside a massive hub.
Includes a compact draggable menu with orbit controls, radius adjustment, speed adjustment, automatic accessory rescanning, weld guarding, collision/touch disabling, respawn handling, and clean unload/re-execution support.
Replication and physics behavior are experience-dependent; the server still has final authority.
Features
- Source -30 accessory physics method
- Live accessory orbit
- Automatic equipped-accessory detection
- Continuously rescans for new accessories
- Detects and detaches recreated accessory welds
- Collision disabled while orbiting
- Touch disabled while orbiting
- Source -30 applied as the final Heartbeat velocity write
- Adjustable orbit radius
- Adjustable orbit speed
- Individual accessory spinning
- Orbit bobbing/motion
- Supports multiple equipped accessories automatically
- Restores accessory joints when orbit is disabled
- Respawn handling
- Draggable compact GUI
- Right Shift menu hide/show
- Safe re-execution/unload handling
- No loadstrings
- Standalone script
- Clean community-oriented source
- Open source / easy to modify
